title: When Does Depth Matter For In-Context Learning? Adaptive Inference in Deep Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2606.16694v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformers perform computations through many successive attention and feedforward blocks, allowing them to learn complex correlations between a large collection of coupled variables. When does stacking successive attention-feedforward computations over many layers provide a computational advantage over a single transformer block? We address this question by examining in-context learning in generalized linear attention transformers. We first introduce a general theory of distributed inference in such transformers, subject to constraints on communication and depth. We show that such systems can exploit internal representations (`function vectors') to infer a latent context variable at increasingly finer scales over its layers. translated_title: 深度何时对上下文学习重要？深度Transformer中的自适应推理
translated_abstract: Transformer通过多个连续的注意力和前馈块执行计算，使它们能够学习大量耦合变量之间的复杂相关性。那么，在多层上堆叠连续的注意力-前馈计算，何时能比单个Transformer块提供计算优势？我们通过研究广义线性注意力Transformer中的上下文学习来回答这个问题。我们首先引入了此类Transformer中分布式推理的一般理论，该理论受限于通信与深度的约束。我们证明，这样的系统可以利用内部表示（“函数向量”）在其各层上以越来越精细的尺度推断潜在上下文变量。对于一个上下文线性回归任务，该理论预测：虽然不含前馈块的单层Transformer对于上下文变量服从高斯先验的情形是最优的，但多层Transformer……
tldr: 本文提出了广义线性注意力Transformer中分布式推理的一般理论，证明多层Transformer可利用“函数向量”内部表示在各层以越来越精细的尺度推断潜在上下文变量，从而阐明了深度堆叠在何种条件下比单层结构具有计算优势。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general theory of distributed inference in generalized linear attention transformers, showing that multi-layer transformers exploit internal "function vectors" to infer latent context variables at increasingly finer scales across layers, thereby clarifying when depth provides a computational advantage over single-block architectures in in-context learning.
